title: 주택임대차계약증서의 확정일자 부여 및 정보제공에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:02986:20210527:00005:part:1/1
title_original: 주택임대차계약증서의 확정일자 부여 및 정보제공에 관한 규칙
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Registration of Real Estate Rules) <Supreme Court Regulation No. 2986, May 27, 2021>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on June 10, 2021.

Article 2
Omitted.

Article 3 (Amendments to Other Rules)
(1) through (3) Omitted.

(4) The Rules on Granting Fixed Dates on Housing Lease Contracts and Provision of Information shall be partially amended as follows:

In Article 6 (4) 1, "a certificate capable of confirming the signer's real name" shall be replaced with "a certificate designated and publicly announced by the Minister of National Court Administration capable of confirming the signer's real name," and paragraph (5) shall be newly inserted in the same Article as follows:

(5) Public notice under paragraph (4) 1 shall be made through the Internet Registry Office.
